Guangzhou is in the south and Harbin in the north, over 3,000 kilometres apart, with very different climates. Guangzhou has almost no winter, while Harbin's generally lasts from October until March or April. Guangzhou's year-round flowers give it the name 'Flower City'; Harbin's winter ice and snow earn it 'Ice City'.
Their dialects differ too. Harbin dialect sounds relatively similar to standard Mandarin, while Guangzhou dialect differs more. Communication would be difficult, and misunderstandings possible, if people used only their local dialects. Many Chinese regions have their own dialects, so children learn standard Mandarin to communicate smoothly.
